facts.fact: Newsmada reports the Interior Ministry launched the 2025 activities of the national civil status and identity centre (Cneci), whose aim is birth certificates carrying a unique authentic biometric identification number, through register digitisation, systematic birth registration, mass biometric enrolment and a biometric ID card.

systems.system: Cneci (Centre national de l'etat civil et de l'identite)

facts.fact: Newsmada reports the Cneci project includes extending the 'systematic birth registration' solution to civil status centres and health facilities, alongside digitisation of civil status registers.

MDG.note: No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.

facts.fact: Newsmada reports the Cneci project aims to deliver birth certificates containing a unique authentic biometric identification number.

MDG.note: The document says nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Newsmada reports the Interior Ministry launched the Cneci 2025 activities, including mass biometric enrolment of the population and issue of the biometric national identity card.

MDG.note: Register digitisation is archive class; the birth registration extension does not say where the digital record is made or in how many offices.
